title: A Teapot to Call Home: Part II
description: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...

mainQuestExcel.title: A Teapot to Call Home: Part II
mainQuestExcel.description: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...

dialogs.text: Wow... this teapot seems even bigger inside than Madame Ping's. There's even a great big house in the middle, too!
Huh, but there's just a whole load of nothing around it...
Get chiseling, Paimon — you could carve us a whole house out of this rock.
Paimon can't do that! Well, you're the one with a sword, anyway — you do it!
Still... why is it so empty here apart from that house?
Oh, wait a second, what is that?
Go dig a burrow to live in for now, I guess?
Hey! There's a perfectly good house right over there. Why should Paimon have to live in a hole in the ground!?
